findings.issue: The docstring (and the module bullet at lines 49-51) describes the right-hand side as "the numerator products over the denominator product", omitting that each numerator set is first augmented with its own denominator (`insert s₁ T₁ * insert s₂ T₂`, not `T₁ * T₂`).
